spans.s:
उत्क उत्क, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. उद्), excited by
the desire of obtaining anything; wishing for (with
inf.), desirous of, longing for; regretting, sad, sor-
rowful; absent, thinking of something else; (अस्), m.
desire; opportunity, occasion.
—उत्क-ता, f. a state of
longing or regret; the plant Pothos Officinalis having
aromatic seeds.
उत्काय, nom. A. -यते, -यितुम्, to long for.

उत्कच उत्-कच, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hairs
erect.
उत्कच; add — hairless; full-blown.

उत्कच्छा उत्-कच्छा, f. a metre of six verses,
each verse containing eleven syllabic instants.

उत्कञ्चुक उत्-कञ्चुक, अस्, आ, अम्, having no
coat of mail, without bodice or jacket.

उत्कट उत्-कट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. उद्), ex-
ceeding the usual measure, important; richly endowed
with, abounding in; drunk, mad, furious; excessive,
much; superior, high, proud, haughty; uneven;
difficult; (अस्), m. fluid dropping from the temples
of an elephant in rut; the plant Saccharum Sara, or
a similar kind of grass; intoxication, pride; (आ), f.
the plant Laurus Cassia; N. of a town; (अम्), n. the
fragrant bark of Laurus Cassia.

उत्कटुकासन उत्कटुकासन, अम्, n. sitting
on the hams, squatting.
उत्कणिका उत्-कणिका, f. a raised particle.

उत्कण्ठ 1. उत्-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
neck uplifted, on the point of doing anything; (अस्
or आ), m. f. longing for a beloved person or thing;
regretting, missing anything or person.

2. उत्कण्ठ, nom. A. उत्कण्ठते, -ठितुम्, to long
[]
for, regret, sorrow, for: Caus. उत्कण्ठयति, -यितुम्,
to excite longing, inspire with tender emotions.

उत्कण्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, regretting, wishing or sor-
rowing for, distressed, sorrowful; (आ), f. a woman
longing after her absent lover or husband.

उत्कन्द् उत्-कन्द् (उद्-स्कन्द्), cl. 1. P. -कन्-
दति, -कन्तुम्, to leap, jump over.
उत्-कन्दक, अस्, m. a kind of disease.

उत्कन्धर उत्-कन्धर, अस्, आ, अम्, having
the neck erect or uplifted; (अम्), n. bending back
the neck.

उत्कम्प् उत्-कम्प् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. A. -कम्पते,
-पितुम्, to tremble: Caus. P. -कम्पयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to tremble; to cause to swing upwards,
agitate, shake.

उत्-कम्प, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, tremor, agita-
tion; (अस्), m. trembling.
उत्-कम्पन, अम्, n. the act of trembling, agitation.

उत्-कम्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, trembling, agitating, causing
to tremble.
उत्कर उत्-कर. See under उत्-कॄ.

उत्-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, what piles or heaps,
what makes up or raises; (अस्), m. what is dug out,
rubbish; heap, multitude; a pile, a stack.
उत्-कार, अस्, m. winnowing corn; piling it up.

उत्कर्कर उत्-कर्कर, अस्, m. a kind of mu-
sical instrument.

उत्कर्ण उत्-कर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, having the ears
erect; (अस्), m. an erect ear.
उत्कर्ष उत्-कर्ष, &c. See under उत्-कृष्.

उत्-कर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, superior, eminent; much,
excessive; exaggerated, boastful; attractive; (अस्), m.
pulling upwards, drawing, pulling; elevation, increase,
rising to something better, prosperity; excellence,
eminence; excess, abundance; self-conceit; boasting;
joy, pleasure (?).

उत्कल् 1. उत्-कल् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 10. P. -कल-
यति, -यितुम्, to unbind, loosen.

उत्कल् 2. उत्-कल् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 10. P. -काल-
यति, -यितुम्, to drive out, expel.

उत्-कलित, अस्, आ, अम्, unbound, loosened; opened,
blossoming; prosperous, rising, increasing; regretting,
grieving for.

उत्कल उत्कल, आस्, m. pl., N. of the inhabit-
ants of Orissa, in the south of India; a subdivision of
Brāhmans, derived from उत्कल, a son of Sudyumna;
(अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a porter, one who travels with
a burden or load; (अस्), m. a fowler, a bird-catcher.

उत्कलाप उत्-कलाप, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
tail erect and expanded.

उत्कलापय, nom. P. -पयति, -यितुम्, to cause
the peacock to spread its tail, to cause any one to be
proud; to inspire conceit by an acknowledgment of
merit; to return thanks (?) .

उत्कलि उत्कलि, इस्, m., N. of a deity; (a
various reading has उत्खरिन्.)

उत्कलिका उत्कलिका, f. (fr. 1. उत्-कल् ?),
longing for, regretting, missing anything or person;
wanton sportfulness, dalliance; a bud, an unblown
flower; a wave.
—उत्कलिका-प्राय, (prose) abound-
ing in compound words.

उत्कषण उत्-कषण, अम्, n. (rt. कष्), tear-
ing or pulling up, drawing through (as a plough).

उत्कस् उत्-कस् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. P., Ved. -क-
सति, -सितुम्, to gape, to open.

उत्काश् उत्-काश् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. A. -काशते,
-शितुम्, to flash upwards, shine.

उत्काका उत्-काका, f. a cow calving every
year.
उत्काशन, अम्, n. giving orders, commanding.

उत्कासन उत्-कासन, अम्, n. (rt. कास्), hem-
ming, clearing the throat of mucus.
उत्कास उत्कास, अस्, m., N. of a man.
उत्कीर्ण उत्-कीर्ण. See under उत्-कॄ 3rd col.

उत्-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped up, scattered, dug
out, perforated.
उत्कीर्त् उत्-कीर्त्. See उत्-कॄत् 3rd col.
उत्कीर्तन उत्-कीर्तन, &c. See उत्-कॄत्.

उत्-कीर्तन, अम्, n. crying out, proclaiming; prais-
ing, celebrating.
उत्कील उत्कील, अस्, m., N. of a man.

उत्कुच् उत्-कुच् or उत्-कुञ्च् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 6. P.,
1. A. -कुचति, -कुञ्चते, -कुञ्चितुम्, to bend upwards;
to bend aside, to bend from the right course, to go
or lead any one astray, to corrupt.

उत्-कुञ्चिका or उत्-कुञ्चिता, f. the plant Nigella
Indica.
उत्-कोच, अस्, m. a bribe.
उत्कोच उत्-कोच. See under उत्-कुच्.

उत्कुट् उत्-कुट् (उद्-क्˚), Caus. -कोटयति, -यि-
तुम्, to bend upwards.

उत्-कुट, अम्, n. lying stretched out on the back,
lying with the face upwards, sleeping with the head
erect.
उत्कूट उत्-कूट, अस्, m. an umbrella or parasol.

उत्-कुटक, अस्, आ, अम्, stretched out on the back
with the face upwards, erect.
—उत्कुटक-प्रहान,
अम्, n. avoiding the above position.
—उत्कुटकासन
(˚क-आस्˚), अम्, n. a position like that just described.
उत्कुण उत्-कुण, अस्, m. a bug; a louse.

उत्कुल उत्-कुल, अस्, आ, अम्, degenerating,
dishonouring one's family.

उत्कूल उत्-कूल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being on
an elevation, going up-hill; (अम्), ind. up-hill.

उत्कूज् उत्-कूज् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. P. -कूजति,
-जितुम्, to utter monotonous sounds.
उत्-कूज, अस्, m. the singing of the kokila.

उत्कूर्द् उत्-कूर्द् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. P. A. -कूर्-
दति, -ते, -दितुम्, to jump up, spring upwards.
उत्-कूर्दन, अम्, n. jumping up, springing upwards.

उत्-कूलित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought to the bank or
shore.

उत्कृ उत्-कृ (उद्-क्˚), cl. 8. A. -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, to inform against.

उत्कॄ उत्-कॄ (उद्-क्˚), cl. 6. P. A. -किरति, -ते,
-करितुम् or -रीतुम्, to scatter upwards, pile up,
heap up; to dig up or out, excavate; to engrave.

उत्-कृति, इस्, f. a metre of four times twenty-six
syllables.

उत्कृत् उत्-कृत् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति,
-कर्तितुम्, to cut out or off, to tear out or off; to
cut up, cut in pieces, carve, butcher.

उत्कॄत् उत्-कॄत् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 10. P. -कीर्तयति,
-यितुम्, to proclaim, celebrate, praise, promulgate.

उत्-कर्तन, अम्, n. cutting up, cutting to pieces,
cutting off.
उत्-कृत्य, ind. having cut off or up, having cut out.

उत्-कृत्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being cut to pieces,
being cut up.

उत्कृष् उत्-कृष् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. P. sometimes
A. -कर्षति, -ते, -कर्ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्, to draw
or drag or pull up; to raise; to draw or take out,
to extract; to pull or put off; to bend (as a bow);
to tear asunder: Caus. -कर्षयति, -यितुम्, to
elevate, raise, increase: Pass. -कृष्यते, to be
lifted or drawn up, to be raised, to rise, become
powerful, become eminent.
उत्-कर्षक, अस्, इका, अम्, drawing upwards, raising.
उत्-कर्षण, अम्, n. drawing upwards, taking off.
उत्-कर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn upwards, elevated.

उत्-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (opposed to अप-कृष्ट
and अव-कृष्ट), drawn up or out; attracted; ex-
tracted; taking a high position; excellent, eminent;
superior, best; much, most, excessive; ज्ञानोत्कृष्ट
(˚न-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, eminent through knowledge.
—उत्कृष्ट-ता, f. or उत्कृष्ट-त्व, अम्, n. ex-
cellence, superiority, eminence.
—उत्कृष्ट-भूम,
अस्, m. a good soil.
—उत्कृष्ट-वेदन, अम्, n.
marrying a man of a higher caste; the best or most
respectable form of marriage (?).
—उत्कृष्टोपाधिता
(˚ट-उप्˚), f. state of high illusion.

उत्-करिका, f. a sort of sweetmeat made with milk,
treacle, and ghee.
उत्-कारिका, f. a poultice.

उत्करीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating or belonging to a
heap &c.

उत्-कीर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, proclaimed, promulgated;
praised, celebrated, renowned.

उत्कॢप् उत्-कॢप् (उद्-क्˚), Caus. P. -कल्पयति,
-यितुम्, to form, fashion, create.

उत्क्रम् उत्-क्रम् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. P. A., 4. P.
-क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्राम्यति, -क्रमितुम्, to
step up, go up, ascend; to step out, go out or away;
to pass away, die; to go over; pass over; omit; not to
notice; to neglect, transgress: Caus. P. -क्रमयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to go up or ascend: Desid. Ved.
-चिक्रमिषति or -चिक्रमिष्यति, to wish to go up
or out.

उत्-क्रम, अस्, m. going up or out; progressive
increase; going astray, acting improperly, deviation,
transgression.

उत्-क्रमण, अम्, n. going up or out, soaring
aloft, stepping out; surpassing, exceeding; (प्राणोत्-
क्रमण, अम्, n. the flight of the soul.)

उत्-क्रमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be abandoned, to
be given up.

उत्-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forth or out, gone over
or beyond, passed, surpassed; trespassing, exceeding.
उत्-क्रान्ति, इस्, f. stepping up to, going out.

उत्क्रान्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, passing, passing away, gone,
departed.

उत्-क्रामत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going out, going over
or above, surpassing.

उत्क्रुश् उत्-क्रुश् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. P. -क्रोशति,
-क्रोष्टुम्, to cry out, to call to (with acc.), ex-
claim; proclaim.

उत्-क्रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, crying, speaking out or
aloud; (अम्), n. crying out, calling, exclaiming, con-
versation.

उत्-क्रोश, अस्, m. clamour, outcry, proclamation;
an osprey.

उत्क्रोद उत्-क्रोद, अस्, m. (fr. क्रुद् = कुर्द्
with उद् ?), Ved. exultation (?); cf. उत्-कूर्द्.

उत्क्लिश् उत्-क्लिश् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 9. P. -क्लिश्नाति,
-क्लेशितुम् or -क्लेष्टुम्, to feel uneasy, to be uncom-
fortable or distressed: Caus. P. -क्लेशयति, -यितुम्,
to excite, stir up, expel.

उत्-क्लेश, अस्, m. excitement, disquietude; disorder
or corruption of the humors (of the body); sickness,
nausea.
उत्-क्लेशक, अस्, m. a kind of poisonous insect.

उत्-क्लेशन, अस्, आ, अम्, or उत्-क्लेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
exciting, stirring up, causing disorder (e. g. कफोत्-
क्लेशिन्, exciting phlegm).

उत्क्लेद उत्-क्लेद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. क्लिद् with
उद्), the becoming wet or moist.
उत्-क्लेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wet, becoming moist.

उत्क्वथ् उत्-क्वथ् (उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. P. -क्वथति,
-थितुम्, to boil out, extract by boiling &c.

उत्-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown upwards, tossed,
raised; thrown out, ejected; vomited; rejected, dis-
missed; (अस्), m. the thorn apple (Datura Metel and
Fastuosa).

उत्क्षिप्तिका, f. an ornament in the shape of a
crescent worn in the upper part of the ear.

उत्-क्षेप, अस्, m. throwing or tossing up; throw-
ing away; sending, despatching; bringing up, vomit-
ing; the region above the temples; N. of a country;
also of a man.

उत्-क्षेपण, अम्, n. throwing upwards, tossing;
sending, sending away; vomiting, taking up; a kind
of basket or bowl used for cleaning corn; a fan; a
measure of sixteen panas.

उत्कुटकासन; add — sitting with the legs bent
underneath.
